Paul Halmos published the five-piece decomposition and the block form of the generic part in his 1969 paper titled Two Subspaces.

Böttcher and Spitkovsky's survey of two-projection theory relates Halmos's representation to earlier formulations by Jacques Dixmier in 1948 and by Chandler Davis in 1958, and to the closely related projection constructions in the Davis–Kahan paper.
